info.name: break-glass-access Postman Collection
info.description:
Emergency access management platform for production systems. Provides 
time-limited, audited, and auto-revoked elevated privileges when normal 
access paths fail during critical incidents. Every session is fully 
recorded for compliance and post-incident review.


OpenAPI version: 1.0.0

variable.description: Override with the base URL of the deployed Apigee proxy.
